title: Binary SIGINT gap: handler installed only once the serving loop starts, after the 'mimid listening' line
description: Found by the tests-notice-flaky agent 2026-11-19: a SIGINT between logging 'mimid listening' and starting the serving loop kills mimid-server with the default action instead of a clean shutdown. Install the signal handler before binding/logging.
close_reason: Fixed in srv-blob-sigint 16f373b: SIGINT/SIGTERM listeners installed at the start of main; binary_smoke sigint_during_startup_stops_cleanly (failed before the fix)
